biggest_catch: User Interviews publishes no official general payout range — every amount is per-study behind an application, so the concrete-payout requirement fails on official terms alone.
catches: No official published pay range; incentive amount and type appear only on individual study pages before applying.
Researchers have up to 10 business days to release payment, and some set longer timelines disclosed per study.
User Testing-branded studies pay 14 days after completion via digital gift card — slower than the usual 1–2 days.
Payment can be withheld for lateness, session incompletion, or policy violations.

c1.evidence: Official participant program is live: 5,000+ studies launch monthly; flow is profile → apply/screen → session → payment.
